mapper.select: SELECT items.product_id AS productId, SUM(items.out_count - items.return_count) AS saleCount FROM erp_sale_order orders INNER JOIN erp_sale_order_items items ON orders.id = items.order_id WHERE orders.status = 20 AND orders.order_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND orders.tenant_id = ${@cn.iocoder.yudao.framework.tenant.core.context.TenantContextHolder@getRequiredTenantId()} AND items.tenant_id = ${@cn.iocoder.yudao.framework.tenant.core.context.TenantContextHolder@getRequiredTenantId()} AND orders.deleted = 0 AND items.deleted = 0 GROUP BY items.product_id

SELECT SUM(orders.out_count - orders.return_count) FROM erp_sale_order orders WHERE orders.status = 20 AND orders.order_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND orders.tenant_id = ${@cn.iocoder.yudao.framework.tenant.core.context.TenantContextHolder@getRequiredTenantId()} AND orders.deleted = 0

SELECT i.product_id, SUM( ( (i.out_count - i.return_count) * i.product_price * (1 + i.tax_percent / 100) ) * (1 - o.discount_percent / 100) ) AS total_sales FROM erp_sale_order o JOIN erp_sale_order_items i ON o.id = i.order_id WHERE o.status = 20 AND o.order_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND i.tenant_id = ${@cn.iocoder.yudao.framework.tenant.core.context.TenantContextHolder@getRequiredTenantId()} AND o.deleted = 0 AND i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.product_id ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 12;

SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.name AS product_name, COALESCE(SUM(s.count), 0) AS stock_count, u.name AS unit_name FROM erp_product p LEFT JOIN erp_stock s ON p.id = s.product_id LEFT JOIN erp_product_unit u ON p.unit_id = u.id WHERE p.status = 0 AND p.tenant_id = ${@cn.iocoder.yudao.framework.tenant.core.context.TenantContextHolder@getRequiredTenantId()} AND s.tenant_id = ${@cn.iocoder.yudao.framework.tenant.core.context.TenantContextHolder@getRequiredTenantId()} AND u.tenant_id = ${@cn.iocoder.yudao.framework.tenant.core.context.TenantContextHolder@getRequiredTenantId()} AND p.deleted = 0 AND s.deleted = 0 AND u.deleted = 0 GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.unit_id, u.name
